description: This file defines a custom exception class 'OrderEntryException' which extends 'APIException'. It serves as a superclass for order entry related exceptions in the OpenMRS project, providing constructors for message and cause.

classes.name: OrderEntryException
classes.description: A superclass of all order entry related exceptions in the OpenMRS API, providing constructors to set exception messages and causes.

methods.name: OrderEntryException(String message)
methods.description: Constructs an OrderEntryException with a specific message.

methods.name: OrderEntryException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructs an OrderEntryException with a specific message and underlying cause.

methods.name: OrderEntryException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Constructs an OrderEntryException with a message key and parameters, used for message localization.
